title: update_marker_or_region result
description: What update_marker_or_region returns, as one of two closed shapes. The tool takes a GUID without being told which kind of thing it addresses, so the result has to say — and a marker has a position while a region has a start and an end, which is not a difference an optional field expresses honestly. Split on the discriminator instead, the way messages/tool-result-partial.schema.json splits an action outcome on success: a region result that carries no end is then a schema violation rather than something the agent has to cope with. Both branches carry the undo report fields defined by messages/tool-result-undo.schema.json, since either update is a mutation.

oneOf.description: A region was updated, so the result carries a span rather than a point.

markerDetail.description: A project marker. The GUID is what addresses it in update_marker_or_region and delete_marker_or_region; the index is what the producer sees in REAPER and is renumbered as markers are added and removed, so it is reported but must not be used for addressing.

index.description: Marker index as assigned by REAPER.

guid.description: A stable REAPER GUID, in REAPER's own braced form.

timelinePosition.description: A position on the project timeline, in seconds from the start.

color.description: Colour as a six-digit hexadecimal RGB string prefixed with #.

undoPositionBefore.description: REAPER undo stack position captured by the extension immediately before this tool applied its change. A "revert all AI changes" operation calls Undo_DoUndo2 in a loop until the stack is back at this position.

undoDescription.description: Undo point description the extension passed to Undo_EndBlock2 for this tool, persisted with the tool_result message so the chat UI can list what the agent changed.

regionDetail.description: A project region. Its start and end are what turn a request framed by section — "render the chorus" — into a time span, so both are always reported.

index.description: Region index as assigned by REAPER.

end.description: Region end position in seconds. Always greater than start — the extension refuses to write a region that is not (Requirement 9.6).
